body:

[schoolgirlcrush] cheaper when colesworths does half price on the mega packs

I bought 2 boxes ! 🐱🐱🐱🐱🐱🐱

[mken] Isn't this like treat food for cats? As in probably worse for them than fast food is for humans? Surely you shouldn't be adding it to their bowl daily right?
[gadgetguy] Yes. Ours get these as occasional treats.
[mken] Thanks, thought maybe I was just being too mean. Our cats love this stuff it's like crack to them but they only get a few pieces here and there, never a bowl full that's for sure.
